summary: 非例行的 ACDE #227：EIP-7997 确定性工厂预部署列为 CFI；合约大小上限（EIP-7907 对 EIP-7954）、EIP-7903 与 EIP-8037 待下次 ACDE；EIP-8058、EIP-7668 与 EIP-7745 被拒。EIP-6404 改用 EIP-7932 签名算法注册表并合并。poojaranjan 提议设立 ACD-G 治理会议。

items.title: ACDE #227
items.note: 21:00（非例行），据 Ethereal news #6：Glamsterdam 目标 2026 年 6 月；EIP-7997 确定性工厂预部署列为 CFI；合约大小上限在 EIP-7907 与 EIP-7954 之间、EIP-7903 与 EIP-8037 待下次 ACDE；EIP-8058 字节码去重折扣、EIP-7668 移除 bloom 过滤器与 EIP-7745 可信日志索引被拒。
items.note_en: 21:00 (off cycle), per Ethereal news #6: Glamsterdam targets June 2026; EIP-7997, the deterministic factory predeploy, is CFI; the contract size limit choice between EIP-7907 and EIP-7954, EIP-7903 and EIP-8037 wait for the next ACDE; EIP-8058 bytecode dedup discount, EIP-7668 removing bloom filters and EIP-7745 trustless log index are declined.

keywords_en: ACDE #227 lists the EIP-7997 deterministic factory predeploy as CFI
leaves the contract size limit and EIP-8037 for later
EIP-6404 moves to the EIP-7932 registry
block and blob propagation under PeerDAS
summary_en: The off cycle ACDE #227: EIP-7997, the deterministic factory predeploy, is CFI; the contract size limit (EIP-7907 versus EIP-7954), EIP-7903 and EIP-8037 wait for the next ACDE; EIP-8058, EIP-7668 and EIP-7745 are declined. EIP-6404 moved to the EIP-7932 signature algorithm registry, merged. poojaranjan proposed an ACD-G governance call.
